INSERT INTO tasks (
            list_id, uid, title, description, due_date, priority,
            completed, completed_at, rrule,
            caldav_href, caldav_etag, raw_icalendar,
            local_version, synced_version, sync_status,
            created_at, updated_at
        )
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 1, 1, 'synced', ?, ?)
